page.layout: One text column, running full width from top to bottom; in the left margin one marginal note, "Hieron, in Catal.", beside the line "damnatus". Printed page number at the head; running head at the top of the page.

main_text.p: simo illo viro non solùm in Epistolâ ad Ro-manos exaratum, sed etiam in ipso agone fuisse repetitum, & Acta martyrij ipsius, & Hieronymus in Scriptorum Catalogo confirmant: verò similiùs esse existimant alij, ut de damnatione. Martyris ad bestias loquutus Irenæus, vocem ab eodem, audito bestiarum rugitu, prolatam potiùs quàm scripto anteà mandatam, memoriæ commendare. hic voluerit. Hæc doctissimus Vsserius non ultra premens hunc Irenæi pro Epistolis Ignatianis locum; quod autem dicit de Actis Martyrij Ignatij & de Hieronymo, verissimum est, nempe testantur ambo verba quæ examinamus ab Ignatio, audito bestiarum rugitu fuisse prolata; cùm jam Hieron, in Catal.dãmnatus, inquit Hieronymus, esset ad bestias, & ardore patiendi rugientes audiret leones, ait: frumentum Christi sum, dentibus bestiarum molar, ut panis mundus inveniar. Cum eo faciunt & Actorum Ignatij descriptores, qui eum ad circumstantes supremum hunc sermonem habuisse ferunt. Viri Romani, qui hoc certamen spectatis, non sine causâ laboravi, non propter pravitatem hæc patior, sed propter pietatem: frumentum Christi sum, dentibus bestiarum molar, ut panis mundus inveniar; Ita Latini apud Adonem Viennensem de festivitatibus Apostolorum D. 1. page.notes: The page begins mid-sentence ("simo illo viro"), a fragment carried over from the previous page. The tilde over the a of "dãmnatus" is read as the abbreviation mark for "mn"; it is uncertain whether it is a tilde or a stray mark. The italic/roman boundaries in the lines "cùm jam damnatus" and "inquit Hieronymus" are read from the scan and may be slightly off. The final line ends with a hyphenated word, "ob-", at the page foot, which continues onto the next page. The printed "Vsserius" is transcribed as "Vsserius" with plain s. No catchword or signature is visible. The faint "Digitized by Google" mark at the bottom right is a digitiser's watermark and is left out.
